2607.11109.title: Generative Chinese Statute Retrieval
2607.11109.paper_summary: Statute retrieval is a fundamental task in legal information retrieval, yet existing approaches struggle to bridge the gap between colloquial legal queries and formal statutory language. In this paper, we propose GCSR, a generative statute retrieval framework that reformulates statute retrieval as a sequence generation problem and internalizes statutory knowledge into a generative model. Specifically, we propose a multi-granularity structured docid that encodes legal hierarchy and semantic information, together with a multi-task training strategy. Experiments show that GCSR consistently outperforms strong sparse, dense, and legal-domain baselines. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of generative retrieval for statute retrieval and highlight its potential for broader legal information access and downstream legal reasoning tasks.
2607.11109.paper_summary_zh: 法條檢索是法律資訊檢索中的一項基本任務，但現有的方法在將口語法律查詢與正式法條語言之間架起橋樑方面面臨困難。在本文中，我們提出了 GCSR，一個生成式法條檢索框架，將法條檢索重新定義為序列生成問題，並將法條知識內化為生成模型。具體而言，我們提出了一種多粒度結構化文檔識別碼，該識別碼編碼了法律層級和語義信息，並結合了一種多任務訓練策略。實驗結果顯示，GCSR 一直優於強大的稀疏、密集和法律領域基準。我們的結果證明了生成檢索在法條檢索中的有效性，並突顯了其在更廣泛的法律信息訪問和下游法律推理任務中的潛力。
